Step into a new era of additive manufacturing—where full automation, cutting‑edge laser technology, and uncompromising quality come standard for aerospace, space, and defense leaders.

Additive Industries’ metal AM systems deliver the quality, reliability, and productivity mission‑critical applications demand. Our four‑laser platform, featuring full‑field coverage and precision calibration, sets a new industry benchmark.

With modular automation enabling up to eight consecutive builds without intervention, you can achieve industry-leading uptime and utilization rates in a single shift—redefining what’s possible in metal 3d printing.

Additive Industries delivers automated, highly scalable metal additive manufacturing (AM) solutions that enable automotive companies to move beyond prototyping and truly industrialise their production. By accelerating manufacturing processes, we help you unlock faster time-to-market and sustained competitive advantage.

Our metal AM systems empower you to push the boundaries of innovation—enhancing quality control, increasing production speed, and strengthening operational safety. All of this is supported by our proven, customer-focused service, ensuring you realise maximum uptime and long-term value.
